claims: C1 within the defined scope of autonomy, the assistant should minimize side effects
C2 irreversible side effects are especially to be minimized
C3 within the defined scope of autonomy, each action should be proportionate to the established objectives

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: the agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the defined scope of autonomy' without defining it

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text speaks of 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries the root level of instruction authority (highest; not overridable by system, developer or user instructions)
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not itself state the authority level

concepts.name: control_side_effects_section
concepts.gloss: the section of the Model Spec that discusses how the assistant should control side effects of its actions

concepts.name: within_scope
concepts.gloss: action A falls within the defined scope of autonomy S
concepts.inference: the clause conditions its guidance on the action being within the defined scope, so a relation between an action and a scope must exist

concepts.name: side_effect
concepts.gloss: action A has side effect E
concepts.inference: minimizing side effects presupposes a relation between an action and the side effects it produces

concepts.name: irreversible_side_effect
concepts.gloss: side effect E cannot be undone or reversed once the action is taken

concepts.name: proportionate_to_objectives
concepts.gloss: action A is proportionate to the established objectives O
concepts.inference: the clause requires each action to be proportionate to the established objectives, so a relation between an action and the objectives must exist

concepts.name: established_objectives
concepts.gloss: the objectives established for the assistant's task
concepts.inference: the clause refers to 'the established objectives' without defining them; they are a fact about the case

asserts.read_back: within the defined scope of autonomy, the assistant should minimize side effects, especially irreversible ones
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), within_scope(A, S), scope_of_autonomy(S), side_effect(A, E)

asserts.read_back: within the defined scope of autonomy, the assistant should especially minimize irreversible side effects
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), within_scope(A, S), scope_of_autonomy(S), side_effect(A, E), irreversible_side_effect(E)

asserts.read_back: within the defined scope of autonomy, the assistant should ensure each action is proportionate to the established objectives
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), within_scope(A, S), scope_of_autonomy(S), established_objectives(O), proportionate_to_objectives(A, O)

closure.reason: the clause states a preference to minimize side effects; it does not forbid actions that have side effects, so silence permits them
the clause states a preference that actions be proportionate; it does not forbid disproportionate actions outright, so silence permits them
